title: Database disk full from runaway export job
reason: The diagnosis correctly points to the database disk being filled by the export job, matching the broken part, problem type, and trigger.
option_titles: Disable export job and move largest export file to root disk, then restart DB
Disable export job and move medium export file to root disk, then restart DB
root_cause: A continuously‑running export job writes large CSV files to the PostgreSQL data directory, filling the /var/lib/postgresql filesystem to 100 % and preventing PostgreSQL from extending its data files or writing WAL, which causes database errors for order POSTs and timeouts on the admin export page.
truth: A new data export job runs every minute and writes large CSV files to /var/lib/postgresql/exports, filling the 50 GB database disk so PostgreSQL cannot write new data.
